title: Dog Night, 2023
logline: Twenty-four years. The alley. This time drawn from the dumpster's side: the man's front, at last, in the private pages — but in the dark, under the hood, the face a shadow. The pup looking up at him.

panels.composition: The alley from beside the dumpster, facing the man: a figure in a rain shell with the hood up, his face a shadow under it, hands in pockets, and the small three-legged dog at his boot looking up at the hood. The sign's dead tubes above. Rain.

characters.pose: facing, face in shadow under a hood

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a rain-dark alley seen from beside a dumpster facing a man in a rain shell with his hood up and his face lost in shadow, a small three-legged dog at his boot looking up at him, a neon sign with dead tubes above, no words
image.notes: From the front, for once. The hood keeps the rule.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: From the front. The hood keeps it.
